game.title: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel
game.blurb: Looter-shooter set on a moon and a space station, from 2K Australia and Gearbox Software (RAWG also lists Aspyr Media and 2K), published by 2K Games, released 2014-10-13. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story milestones, all hidden on Steam, plus a few other hidden feats. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Missions and Exploration
chapters.summary: Side missions, named locations in each area and aboard the Helios Space Station, Moonstone Chests and the Moxxtails in Concordia.

chapters.title: Levels, Gear and Skills
chapters.summary: Character levels, the Grinder, customization items, purple gear, challenges, VaultHunter.EXE and the skills named in the achievements (Wolf, the Aspis and Showdown).

chapters.title: Co-op and Duels
chapters.summary: Reviving other players with Oxygen and winning a duel.

chapters.title: Combat and Low Gravity
chapters.summary: Freezing and slam attacks, elemental effects, airborne sniper kills, the Stingray, suffocation and the Lost Legion.

chapters.title: The Holodome Onslaught
chapters.summary: The five rounds of The Holodome and its Badass Round.

chapters.title: Later Hidden Block
chapters.summary: Nine hidden achievements and one SpyBug feat at the end of the Steam list. They may belong to the later add-on RAWG lists (Claptastic Voyage), but the data does not say. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3543). Steam app 261640 ("Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel") was used; its schema is named "Cork" (an internal codename). StrategyWiki redirects "Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel" to "Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel!", a stage 0 page: only Controls and Table of Contents are written; Walkthrough, Gameplay and Challenges are linked but not written. borderlands.fandom.com answers the API under "Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel" with about 124 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 30 of 63 Steam achievements are hidden. Achievement_1 to Achievement_12 (82% down to 33%) look like story milestones; they, Achievement_13 to 18 and the hidden 22, 24 and 25 sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. The Holodome achievements (51 to 53) say "The Holodome", which matches RAWG's add-on "Ultimate Vault Hunter Upgrade Pack: The Holodome Onslaught". Achievement_54 to 62 are hidden and, with the visible Achievement_63 ("No Photographs, Please!"), sit after the Holodome block; RAWG's later add-on is "Ultimate Vault Hunter Upgrade Pack 2: Claptastic Voyage" (2015-03-24), but nothing in the data ties these ten to it, so their chapter is a guess by list position. RAWG also lists the Lady Hammerlock Pack, Handsome Jack Doppelganger Pack and Shock Drop Slaughter Pit; no achievement names them.
